name: Lacustrine-Cirque
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in massive canyon systems. Travelers navigate by a nearby asteroid belt and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
The air carries burnt sugar and sulfur, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Instruments disagree about the temporal distortion zone: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
